description: Screenshot coverage for every module, final repo-wide grep gate, and the side-by-side visual review inputs.
steps: Generate the full route list from src/router/index.tsx (about 204 path entries) and extend ROUTES in e2e/smoke.spec.ts to cover at least one route of EVERY module and every distinct page type (list, form, detail, dashboard with charts, settings tab, empty state, modal, public page). Skip dynamic ':id' routes by using mock ids already supported by e2e/fixtures.ts, or add a fixture mock. Keep assertHealthy. Add Button/IconButton and Select element states (hover, disabled) shots only if cheap.

Run `SHOT_DIR='/Users/admin/Documents/GitHub/Leadspoint CRM/hrms-frontend/.agents/tasks/minimal-ui-pass2/screens' SHOT_NAME=after2 npx playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts` and the full suite. Screens are NOT committed.

Write scripts/ nothing; run the final grep gate commands and record the output plus a list of justified exceptions in the FEAT findings: `grep -rnE '<button\b' src --include=*.tsx | grep -v ui/Button`, `grep -rnE '<select\b' src | grep -v ui/Select`, emoji regex over src, `grep -rnE '(bg|text|border|ring|from|to|divide)-(red|green|blue|orange|purple|amber|yellow|gray|slate|zinc|emerald|indigo|pink|teal|cyan|sky|violet|rose)-[0-9]+|#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b' src/pages`.
Record the final gate numbers (tsc, oxlint, vitest, vite build, playwright count).
acceptance_criteria: Playwright screenshot spec covers every module (list in findings), all passing
